keyTakeawayCard.direct: Buffer: The Unfair Advantage turns creating margin for uncertainty into a working discipline. McKeown shows how people build plans with no margin and then act shocked when reality interrupts the schedule, then answers with a harder rule: prepare buffers through scenario planning, larger time estimates, and resilience against the foreseeable surprise. The chapter matters because the execute section begins by building the slack that keeps the essential plan from collapsing at first contact with reality.
